name: exams-generator
description: Write programming exams whose reference solution is checked by a real compiler and rendered to PDF

exams_dir.title: Exams directory
exams_dir.description: Where exams are stored and committed. Use a clone of a private git repository: exams contain their solutions. Course profile and overrides go in .exams-config inside it.

locale.title: Default exam language
locale.description: Language new exams are written in. An exam can still choose another.

run_demos.title: Allow executing demos (run_demos tool)
run_demos.description: Off by default. When on, the server can execute solutions inside a bubblewrap sandbox. Linux only; read the 'Running demos' section of the README first.
